payload.detail: PARTIAL 2026-09-18 (PR #2881, merged). useDifferentialSearch now carries the degraded flag in state and in its LRU entry, so a cache hit cannot quietly heal it, and merges the diagnosis and presentation requests with OR because a result card does not say which catalogue it came from; the search results band shows the pinned catalogueDegradedNotice wording. STILL OPEN, which is why this row is not closed: the compact 'Also in...' strip (universal-search-also-matches.tsx) filters to groups with items and shows no notice, unlike the command surface it sits beneath.
